instructions: Read the complete skill catalogue through read_policy. It contains the installed names, descriptions and user-invocable flags. For each independent request, select the one skill that fits its entry-command or configured-slot context. Use only the supplied catalogue and request. Submit the exact listed skill name as a JSON string value through submit_output, once per case. Do not execute or read any skill body, query a tracker, change files or perform the described work. These are discovery choices, not workflow execution. Finish after every selection is recorded.

tools.name: read_policy
tools.description: Read the unchanged policy in bounded chunks. Start at offset 0, then use each returned next_offset until it is null. Complete policy delivery is required before workflow operations. No scratch file is needed.

tools.name: submit_output
tools.description: Persist one completed named output in the JSON shape requested by its case. The controlled caller consumes a termination policy through the real CLI. Submit once per case.

tools.name: finish
tools.description: Finish after submitting all independent requested outputs.

cases.request: The user explicitly invokes /faff with no further request. Select the gateway itself; its body owns any further routing.
